title: How to Introduce Active Ingredients into Skincare
ex: A slow, week-by-week plan to add actives safely, which ingredients to keep apart, and how to layer products for dark spots.
rt: How to Introduce Active Ingredients | Mirc Glow
rd: How to introduce active ingredients into skincare: a 6-week plan, which actives to keep apart, how to layer products for dark spots and signs to slow down.
keyword: how to introduce active ingredients into skincare
quick: Add one new active at a time, patch test it, and start with two or three nights a week. If your skin stays comfortable, increase slowly and wait 2–4 weeks before adding another. Wear sunscreen every morning, especially with brightening-focused ingredients.
facts: Introduce only one new active at a time.
Start with two or three nights a week.
Keep kojic acid and retinol on different nights at first.
